name: Confocal steady-state and time-resolved photoluminescence of exfoliated monolayer WSe2 at 4 K (4-120 K series)
plain_name: Record the light given off by a one-atom-thick semiconductor cooled to 4 K
description: Monolayer WSe2 on 90 nm SiO2/Si is excited at 525 nm through a 0.82 NA objective inside a closed-cycle helium cryostat; exciton, trion, biexciton, dark-trion and defect emission (747 nm) are resolved at 4 K and their time-resolved decays followed up to 120 K.
keywords: Record the light given off by a one-atom-thick semiconductor cooled to 4 K

sources.citation: Thekkooden I., Jana S., Deka M., Nanda B. R. K., Bhallamudi V. P. Long Non-Exponential PL Decay from Localised Defect States in Monolayer WSe2 at Low Temperature. arXiv:2607.18423 (2026)

requirements.rationale: The five-peak spectrum and defect lifetimes are taken at a 4 K sample temperature.
Optional: the temperature-dependent TRPL series spans 4-120 K (above 77 K the authors also used an LN2-cooled stage).
The laser must reach the flake and the PL must be collected optically.
Optional: high-NA (0.82) collection partially captures dark-exciton emission.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
